notes.title: Mischance 1.1 - Full Release Update
notes.notes:
[b]I am happy to announce that [u]Mischance is now out of Early Access![/u][/b]

[h2]Bug Fixes & Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed the tips screen staying on screen when "Heading to work".
[*]Fixed the music slider to actually remember the volume you set it at now.
[*]Reduced transition times between actions (less time to fade in and out of work/sleep).
[*]Added a button to change wall themes of the house. You can now switch between 4 styles.
[*]Added some visual changes to the house.
[*]Minor visual overhaul to the Main Menu.
[/list]
[h2]An Important Note from the Developer[/h2]

This has been a long and insightful journey into the depths of game development, game design, learning the technicals of publishing a game on steam and player feedbacks! For a first game, I am proud of the experience and also super grateful to all the support till this day.

Unfotunately, Mischance is still not what I had initially envisioned it to be. I was quite ambitious with the game, and due to several obstacles (the pandemic, lack of motivation, personal stress) I ended up adding a lot less content than I would have hoped.

Regardless, this is still a very important lesson to me. I have learned that making a game involves a lot of steps besides the core development itself. The marketing, pipeline, asset creation, story-writing are some examples of several factors to keep in mind when developing a game- especially when you're the solo developer.

All things come to end, both good and bad. After spending more than a year and a half working on Mischance, [u]I have finally decided to stop development and move on to newer projects.[/u] I will keep in mind what worked and what didn't work in Mischance and apply those lessons in games I will develop in the future. If I get the inspiration again, I might come back to Mischance. But for the forseeable future I shall be focusing on developing other games. I am excited for the journey from this point onwards.

A huge thanks for anyone who's bought my game, supported me on patreon and all my friends and family for supporting me through this phase. The development of Mischance will always be a nice memory for me and one of the early steps towards my career as a game designer.

Wishing you all a healthy and properous life!
Mustang

notes.title: Adding Achievements to Mischance - Mischance 0.6
notes.notes:
[h1]Good news to all Achievement Hunters[/h1]

Mischance now offers several achievements which are guaranteed to make the game exploration more worthy. Some achievements are death specific, which means you will have to explore all different kinds of game endings to unlock them. So get hunting folks!

But that's not all, I've also worked on fixing some game-breaking bug fixes.
- On some occasions, after washing hands the player could get soft locked in place. It was difficult to pinpoint and replicate the bug, but I managed to find a simple workaround.
- You could bring up the Tip Display as you interact with any object. This has been fixed.

Thank you for patiently waiting as I took a small break from the project. Expect an update or two this month with more content! 

If you wish to contact me feel free to join the official Mischance Discord server: discord.gg/huCjEr7

Keep on gaming,
Mustang

notes.title: Mischance 0.5.6 - Story Mode
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38032845/16e4c2a52fac3343adb66877bcaf933f3cffc5e8.png[/img]

It's finally here! After almost half a year, mischance is back with an update- a bigger one this time. No longer will you have to survive for an indefinite period.

[h2][b]Temporary Curse[/b][/h2]
The relic you touch binded you in a very powerful curse. But just like most curses, this one can also be broken. Your objective is to survive for 30 days by making some smart decisions and hoping for luck to be in your favour.
[i]The reason for this change is so that players can have a simple goal to reach. You can now complete the game by reaching day 30. This also helps me focus on a more detailed and limited storyline for future updates.[/i]

[h2][b]Modes of transport[/b][/h2]
A lot can happen on your way to work. And that depends on HOW you go to work. You have 3 options to choose from now-
[list]
[*]Travelling by foot
[*]Travelling by bus
[*]Skipping Work
[/list]
[i]Each of these options have different gameplay advantages and disadvantages. As you live through more days, these options can play a big factor in your chances of survival.
[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38032845/3977366a166d477680e5d030d715583fa80edcb1.png[/img]

[h2]Additional Features[/h2]
This update adds some minor features and changes that also help enchance the overall experience of Mischance.
[list]
[*] Added tips for some of the common activities performed in the game
[*] Different background tracks for Week 1, Week 2, Week 3, and Week 4
[*] Added more scenarios
[*] Added 4 more ways to die
[*] Player can hallucinate, having random texts appear around the house at certain days
[*] Game Over screen shows days survived and probability of death (may not always be accurate)
[*] Added or replaced some props in the house
[*] Added Intro video and End Credits
[*] More UI and Gameplay Tweaks
[*] Subtle Lighting Changes
[/list]

[i][b]I would like to apologise for the delay in the update. Working on a game alone is a lot more draining mentally than I anticipated. Thank you for your patience, and I hope you enjoy the new update. As always, if you wish to get in contact with me or have any game suggestions, make sure to join the official discord server![/b][/i]

Discord - discord.gg/huCjEr7
Youtube - www.youtube.com/theragingmustang
Twitter - https://twitter.com/rage_mustang

notes.title: Mischance Update 0.5.4 - Fever Death
notes.notes:
I am proud to announce a new challenge in Mischance- The Flu! 

Taking care of your health and hygiene is more important now than ever. And it's only fair that you stay healthy in the game as well. And as a good reminder to stay clean, there are now consequences for not doing so. Better wash your hands more often now!

I would also like to apologise for the radio silence. There were some hiccups along the development of mischance this month which slowed down the amount of progress I could achieve. At the same time, I did not want to keep the players waiting too long for an update, which is why you can expect another update in the next few weeks with even more features!

What's new in 0.5.4-
[list]
[*]Graphical improvements (Post-processing, Ambient Occlusion, Bloom)
[*]UI changes and fixes
[*]Added a pause menu for easier navigation
[*][b]A fever check which will be called if the player does not maintain their personal hygiene [/b]
[*]Gameplay balance fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Mischance Update 0.5.3 - Economy System
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38032845/031e179229b59ef9c8acdd405208e9f60d729f30.png[/img]

Hey everyone! I am happy to announce the release of Mischance 0.5.3, which now has a money system! 
Players start with a small sum of money and receive a paycheck every few days. This money can then be used to buy new items from the store, which can be accessed through the laptop.

Until now the gameplay would basically be over in the 2nd week because of the high chance of the fan falling. Hate having an unreliable fan? Well, maybe there might be something just for you in the store ;)

Additional Features:
- A Popup system that provides instructions/updates
- The laptop is now interactable
- Every day now ends with an "Expenses" tab that displays your food or other payment expenditure
- Adiditional SFX
- New Soundtrack

Upcoming Features:
- A pause menu system to turn off music or exit to home screen
- More features in the laptop
- Additional death scenarios

I would like to apologise for the delay in updates, and I hope this one brings more fun to the overall experience in the game. I'd also like to thank all of you (especially my patreon supporters) for the everlasting support <3
